facts.fact: Ghana's Ministry of Health says it is developing a National AI Health Policy and Guidelines with accountability mechanisms, addressing risks including patient data privacy and algorithmic bias.
facts.system: National AI Health Policy and Guidelines

GHA.note: The document states no government body using an AI system, only a health policy under development.
The 44% using or piloting AI figure is from stakeholder respondents and names no public health system tool.
The document names no AI model, dataset or computing built or hosted in Ghana.
